sql: SELECT TOP 1 c.ZnodeCategoryId AS categoryId, a.Name AS firstNameAscName, a.SKU AS firstNameAscSku, a.ZnodeProductId AS firstNameAscProductId, z.Name AS firstNameDescName, z.SKU AS firstNameDescSku, z.ZnodeProductId AS firstNameDescProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity v ON v.VersionId = c.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = c.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = pc.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h ON h.PimCategoryHierarchyId = c.ZnodeCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct acp ON acp.PimCategoryId = h.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity a ON a.ZnodeProductId = acp.PimProductId AND a.VersionId = c.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct zcp ON zcp.PimCategoryId = h.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity z ON z.ZnodeProductId = zcp.PimProductId AND z.VersionId = c.VersionId WHERE v.RevisionType = @revisionType AND v.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND v.LocaleId = @localeId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND p.StoreCode = @store AND c.ZnodeCategoryId = @categoryId AND acp.Status = @isActive AND zcp.Status = @isActive AND a.IsActive = @isActive AND z.IsActive = @isActive AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, c.ZnodeCategoryId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, a.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @zero AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, c.ZnodeCategoryId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, z.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @zero AND a.Name < z.Name ORDER BY a.Name, a.ZnodeProductId, z.Name DESC, z.ZnodeProductId DESC
